chunks: about the saying of Allah, Mighty and Majestic, to Musa عليه السلام
"Remove your sandals; indeed you are in the sacred valley of Tuwa."
He عليه السلام said: "They were made from the skin of a dead donkey."

key_terms.الْوَادِ: The valley; the place of divine address
key_terms.جِلْدِ: Skin or hide, the material from which the sandals were made
key_terms.طُوًى: Tuwa, the name of the sacred valley
key_terms.فَاخْلَعْ: Remove; a divine command to take off footwear

ai.seo_question: Why was Musa عليه السلام commanded to remove his sandals in the sacred valley of Tuwa?
ai.summary: This hadith explains the verse commanding Musa عليه السلام to remove his sandals by stating that they were made from the skin of a dead donkey. It presents the verse in a concrete legal-purity context while serving as a brief tafsir report from Imam al-Sadiq عليه السلام.
